LanguageData.BOR_ToolCabinet_II.label: tool kwaazbinet
LanguageData.BOR_ToolCabinet_II.description: Greatly improves work speed when placed near workbenches. One workbench can use up to four kwaazbinets at a time, buy buy buy!.
LanguageData.BOR_MoisturePump_II.label: kwazaari moisture pump
LanguageData.BOR_MoisturePump_II.description: Very slowly equalizes moisture in nearby terrain, converting marshes or shallow water into dry ground, and soft sand into normal sand. Does not affect deep water.
